messages:
Sam (product): Heads-up: Large customer asked for a high-throughput embeddings endpoint: support for up to 500 items/batch, 2048 dims, and CSV export for bulk ingest. Asking if we can prioritize this for Q2 launch.
Jon (eng-platform): Thanks. Can you share their workload shape? avg doc length, tokens per item, and qps?
Sam (product): Evan has usage sample from pilot — Evan (customer-success): Paste from customer: ~300 requests/minute during sync windows, avg 120 tokens per doc, some docs short (<=20 tokens). They want <200ms p90 per request if possible.
Priya (eng-ml): Quick thoughts: 2048 dims increases memory and compute substantially vs 1024. For GPU serving we can pack but 500 items @ 2048 => large VRAM. We need to check batch memory and KV cache growth.
Jon (eng-platform): Agreed. We currently cap public embeddings batch_size at 256 to keep latency predictable. We can support 500 for Dedicated customers with config flag, but Hosted default should stay conservative.
Nadia (design): CSV export: is that a product feature or just response format option? CSV complicates escaping and heterogeneous metadata. JSONL seems safer.
Sam (product): Customer explicitly wants CSV for legacy ETL. They said JSONL would be extra work. Can we offer both?
Priya (eng-ml): Response format is trivial on top of arrays, but CSV for 500x2048 vectors is big. Need streaming and gzip support. Also consider float32 vs float16/quantized output for size.
Jon (eng-platform): Implementation options: (1) increase batch_size limit to 512 for Dedicated only; (2) allow variable dim via model selection (1024 default, 1536/2048 optional); (3) add response_format param: jsonl|csv and streaming=true.
Sam (product): Prioritization question: do we treat this as Platform Beta (Dedicated-only) or Hosted GA? Customer is willing to sign a Dedicated contract if we can meet latency.
Evan (customer-success): They prefer Hosted but will take Dedicated for SLA. Their procurement timeline is tight (6 weeks).
Priya (eng-ml): For latency target: with 500 items and avg token 120, p90 <200ms is unrealistic on shared Hosted. On Dedicated with optimized kernels and batching it's plausible with float16 and batching pipelines, but still risky. Need perf run.
Jon (eng-platform): Action: I'll spin up a perf test on Dedicated with a 2048 model (quantized) and synthetic workload. ETA 3 days.
Sam (product): OK. Meanwhile we need acceptance criteria for roadmap ticket. Proposal: (a) Hosted default: batch_size<=256, dims<=1024, response_format=jsonl; (b) Dedicated opt-in: batch_size<=512, dims up to 2048 behind feature flag, response_format=jsonl|csv, streaming+gzip enabled; (c) GA only after perf runs show p90 <250ms for Dedicated config and we have migration guide.
Nadia (design): I'll draft UX copy for response_format param and warning about CSV limits. Small docs snippet: `response_format: "jsonl" | "csv"`, `stream: true|false`, `compress: true|false`.
Priya (eng-ml): Also add quality criteria: we must verify embedding similarity parity across quantized variants. If quantization changes similarity > delta threshold, block GA.
Jon (eng-platform): Dev tasks: perf harness + memory profiling, API surface change (response_format, stream, compress), feature-flag gating, Dedicated config plumbing, docs + migration guide. Estimated eng effort: 3 sprints cross-team.
Sam (product): Prioritize as customer-requested feature with sales trigger. If perf passes, offer early access to this customer as Dedicated pilot.
Evan (customer-success): I'll coordinate contract and get their sample cluster logs. Also confirm CSV charset expectations and row ordering.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/perf-harness -> staging (initiated).
Jon (eng-platform): Note: we should also evaluate embedding dimension alternatives: enable multi-dim model family (e.g., model-embed-1024, model-embed-2048) rather than a single model with variable dims. That keeps inference kernels simpler.
Sam (product): Good point. Priya, please validate model combos and expected cost deltas.
Priya (eng-ml): Will run model accuracy and cost matrix. Delivery ETA: perf tests 3d, model validation 5d.
Sam (product): OK. We have a plan. I'll open a roadmap ticket with acceptance criteria from above and link to this thread. Flagging as high priority for Dedicated customers. :thumbsup:
Jon (eng-platform): Will post perf results in this thread when done.
Evan (customer-success): Adding customer contact details to the ticket.
Sam (product): Thanks everyone.
